cover.headline: The best franchise in Indian internet, priced about right: HOLD
cover.lead: Info Edge owns **Naukri.com**, India's dominant jobs marketplace (FY26 Recruitment revenue ₹2,256 cr at a 57% segment margin), the property site 99acres, Jeevansathi and Shiksha, and **12.4% of Eternal and 12.1% of PB Fintech**. On 30-Sep-2026 those two stakes were worth ₹686 a share, 56% of the ₹1,220 price, and cash another ₹78. We value the company the way the street does, as a **sum of the parts**: Recruitment at **23.5x** Sep-28E profit (the median of the current street multiples), 99acres at 3.75x sales, the stakes at market less a **9% holding-company discount** (Info Edge's own median since Sep-2025: the full Sep-2021 to Jun-2026 median is a large premium, because the market paid 40-90x for Naukri until mid-2025), unlisted investments at book and cash. That gives **{{dcf.tp|inr}} ({{dcf.upside|chg}}): we initiate with HOLD.** Bull {{scen.bull.tp|inr}} (Naukri at 30x, no discount); bear {{scen.bear.tp|inr}} (AI slows hiring, Naukri at IndiaMART's 20x, a 40% discount).

arguments.p: Recruitment billings rose 17.5% in Q1FY27 (GCCs +31%, IT/BPM +15%) after ~10% a year in FY26, and the segment margin reached 58.3%. AI products (AI-Rex at 4,000+ enterprises, candidate services +35%) are adding revenue, not taking it. We forecast Recruitment revenue +14.5% / +13% / +12% and profit after corporate costs of ₹1,298 cr on a Sep-28E basis.

arguments.h: The market has already re-priced Naukri
arguments.p: With the stakes at JM Financial's 25% discount, the price implied ~52x next-year Recruitment profit over 2021-26 (median) and ~28x on 30-Sep-2026. IndiaMART, the only other classifieds stock with a long history, trades 59% below its own five-year median P/E. At 23.5x the operating businesses are worth ₹523 a share in our SOTP.

arguments.h: More than half of what you buy is Eternal and PB Fintech
arguments.p: The stakes (₹592 + ₹94 a share) dominate the value and the share price follows them: every 10% move in Eternal is ~₹54 a share. Info Edge has not sold a share of either since the IPOs. Since early 2026 the market has applied a discount (11% on 30-Sep-2026 on our convention); we assume 9%.

The street (median ₹1,350) is more positive mostly because it uses a higher Naukri multiple (JM 30x) or no discount (Motilal Oswal). Measured consistently, a higher Naukri multiple also means a wider measured discount, so the target barely moves (₹1,290 at 30x). The stock needs either faster Naukri growth or a rally in Eternal to offer 15%.

catalysts: Q2FY27 results (due by mid-November 2026): whether Recruitment billings hold above 15% and 99acres turns profitable for a full quarter.
Eternal's and PB Fintech's share prices: together ~56% of Info Edge's market value.
The pre-results business update for Q2FY27 (Info Edge publishes standalone billings within about ten days of the quarter-end).
Any sale of Eternal or PB Fintech shares, a buyback or a special dividend: none announced.
AI products (AI-Rex, Talent Pulse) moving from pilots to scaled revenue; price increases in Naukri.

sections.title: India's job-classifieds monopoly, with a venture portfolio attached

blocks.p: Info Edge runs India's largest online classifieds businesses. **Naukri.com** is where Indian white-collar hiring happens: 118 mn resumes, ~6.97 lakh live jobs and ~1.46 lakh paying recruiters in FY26. Around it sit NaukriGulf (Gulf hiring), Job Hai (blue-collar), candidate services (Naukri 360, FastForward, AI resume and interview tools), AmbitionBox (company reviews), Hirist (tech hiring) and Zwayam/DoSelect (hiring software). **99acres.com** is the traffic leader in property classifieds; **Jeevansathi.com** a matrimony site (plus the Aisle dating app); **Shiksha.com** a college-discovery site. For many years Info Edge has also invested in start-ups from its balance sheet and through venture funds (AIFs) it manages; two of those investments, Zomato (now Eternal) and Policybazaar (PB Fintech), became large listed companies.

blocks.p: Two numbers frame the stock. First, **the two listed stakes are worth ₹686 a share, 56% of the ₹1,220 price**, and cash adds ₹78. Second, what is left for the operating businesses (~₹412 a share, or ~18.0x our Sep-28E Recruitment profit if the stakes are at full market value) is low for a business with a 57% segment margin and no competitor of similar scale. The stock is cheap on Naukri only if the market should not discount the stakes, and the market has discounted them since early 2026.

blocks.callout: **Why this matters for the numbers:** every few years an investee lists, merges or is written down, and the accounts book a large gain or loss. Reported EPS has gone ₹22 (FY21) → ₹198 → loss → ₹8.9 → ₹14.9 → ₹22.4. None of that is the operating business. We forecast no fair-value gains and value the stakes at market instead.

sections.title: Online classifieds: winner-takes-most markets, now tested by AI

blocks.p: Classifieds are two-sided marketplaces: job-seekers go where the jobs are and recruiters pay to reach the most candidates, so the leader tends to keep winning. In Indian white-collar hiring that leader is Naukri. Online job classifieds in India are a near-monopoly for Naukri in white-collar hiring: 118 mn resumes, ~25,000 added and ~8.6 lakh modified a day, 1.46 lakh billed customers in FY26 (Q1FY27 deck). Competitors are LinkedIn (professional network, strong in premium hiring), foundit (ex-Monster India), Indeed and Apna/WorkIndia in blue-collar hiring. Demand is driven by IT services and GCC hiring (~45% of B2B billings incl. GCCs), consultants (~24%) and other sectors (~28%).

99acres competes with Housing.com/PropTiger (REA Group), MagicBricks (Times Internet), NoBroker and builders' own channels; management estimates the new-project advertising market at over Rs5,000 cr. 99acres' web time-share was 49% and app 55% in Q1FY27 (SimilarWeb). Jeevansathi is number two or three behind Matrimony.com (BharatMatrimony) and Shaadi.com; strongest in Hindi-speaking markets (45%+ profile share). Shiksha (college discovery and study-abroad counselling) is losing referred search traffic as AI answers replace search results.

blocks.callout: **AI is the new question.** Management's view (Q1FY27 call): where Info Edge owns both sides of the marketplace and the data (Naukri, 99acres, Jeevansathi), AI strengthens the business; where traffic came through third-party search (Shiksha), AI is a headwind. The bear case is different: AI may reduce white-collar hiring itself (IT services hire fewer freshers) and let recruiters source candidates from many places. Q1FY27 does not show that yet: IT/BPM billings grew 15% and GCC billings 31%.

blocks.p: Billings lead revenue by about two quarters (Naukri sells annual subscriptions and recognises them over the year), so the Q1FY27 acceleration shows up in revenue through FY27. Deferred revenue for Recruitment was ₹1,145 cr at Jun-2026, 13% higher than a year earlier.

sections.title: Recruitment: a 58%-margin near-monopoly, growing faster again

blocks.p: Recruitment earned a ₹1,277 cr segment result on ₹2,256 cr of revenue in FY26 (56.6%). Growth slowed sharply after the FY22-23 IT hiring boom (revenue +46% in FY23, +7.5% in FY24) and recovered to +13.8% in FY26. Q1FY27 was better: billings +17.5%, revenue +13%, segment margin 58.3% (52.5% a year earlier). By customer, GCCs (+31%) and IT/BPM (+15%) led; recruitment consultants (+1%) lagged. Management says hiring is still mostly replacement-led, with premium hiring growing 25-30% and mid-tier volumes weak.

blocks.callout: **Our view:** Naukri is the best business in Indian internet: a dominant marketplace, paid in advance, with margins that keep rising. The debate is growth, not quality. We assume 12-14.5% revenue growth (billings were +17.5% in Q1) and half a point of margin a year. The risk to that is AI shrinking white-collar hiring, not a competitor.

sections.title: 99acres: the traffic leader is finally close to making money

blocks.p: 99acres lost ₹69 cr in FY24, ₹48 cr in FY25 and ₹59 cr in FY26 while Info Edge spent to become the clear traffic leader (web time-share 49%, app 55%, iOS 69% in Q1FY27). Q4FY26 showed a small profit, helped by a one-off ₹20.5 cr write-back; Q1FY27 was close to break-even (loss ₹2 cr against ₹19 cr a year earlier) with billings +16.5%. Management says the investment phase is behind it, expects the business to be cash-generative in FY27 and targets 25-30% margins in the long run. We assume 1.5% / 7% / 12% margins.

sections.title: Jeevansathi grows; Shiksha shrinks; the subsidiaries still lose money

blocks.p: Jeevansathi (revenue ₹38.5 cr in Q1FY27, +14%) has turned profitable after years of losses and is growing billings ~14-28%; the Aisle dating app (a subsidiary) grew billings 44%. Shiksha (₹44 cr, −12%) is losing referred search traffic to AI answers; it stays slightly profitable but billings fell 23%. Outside the standalone company, the subsidiaries (Aisle, Coding Ninjas, Zwayam, DoSelect, 4B Networks) and the venture funds' running costs lost about ₹62 cr at EBITDA in FY26 and ~₹22 cr in Q1FY27. We value Jeevansathi and Shiksha at 2x sales and the subsidiaries at their carrying value; their losses are small next to Naukri's profit.

sections.title: The portfolio: Eternal and PB Fintech are worth ₹686 a share

blocks.p: Info Edge holds **119.96 cr Eternal shares (12.43% diluted)**, worth ₹38,386 cr at ₹320.00 on 30-Sep-2026 (cost ₹146 cr), and **5.75 cr PB Fintech shares (12.12%)**, worth ₹6,116 cr at ₹1063.90 (cost ₹568 cr). It has not sold either since the IPOs, apart from the 4.93 cr Zomato shares in the 2021 offer for sale. Its nominee (founder Sanjeev Bikhchandani) sits on Eternal's board. The rest of the portfolio (~135 companies across AI, deep-tech, consumer and SaaS themes, ~₹4,900 cr invested including other investors' money in its AIFs) is carried at ₹2,828 cr for Info Edge's share. We value it at book: it is 4% of the market value and has produced as many write-offs as winners.

blocks.p: **Verdict.** Naukri has a real and wide moat: network effects (the most candidates attract the most recruiters, and the reverse), paid-in-advance subscriptions, a 56.6% segment margin and no competitor of similar scale in Indian white-collar hiring after decades. LinkedIn is the closest threat at the premium end. 99acres has scale in traffic but not yet in profit; Jeevansathi is a distant challenger and Shiksha's model is being undermined by AI search. The moat is in one business, and that business is ~74% of standalone revenue and all of its profit.

blocks.callout: **What would break the moat:** a shift in how hiring happens (AI agents sourcing candidates across the open web and social networks; companies hiring through their own platforms) rather than a rival job board. Management argues that owning both sides of the marketplace and the resume data makes Naukri stronger in an AI world, and so far the numbers agree: billings accelerated in Q1FY27 and AI products are selling.

sections.title: The operating business doubled in four years; reported profit is mostly fair-value gains

blocks.p: Info Edge's standalone business (Naukri, 99acres, Jeevansathi, Shiksha) grew revenue from ₹1,563 cr in FY22 to ₹3,052 cr in FY26 (18% a year) and operating profit before other income from ₹419 cr to ₹1,138 cr (28% a year). Almost all of it is Recruitment: its segment result was ₹1,277 cr in FY26, more than the whole standalone operating profit, because 99acres still lost ₹59 cr. Reported consolidated profit tells a different and misleading story: ₹12,760 cr in FY22 (the Zomato listing gain), a loss in FY23 (write-downs), ₹1,450 cr in FY26. It swings with fair-value gains on the venture funds, write-offs of start-ups and the losses of consolidated subsidiaries. Standalone EPS before exceptional items, the number management reports, rose from ₹7.16 (FY22) to ₹17.04 (FY26), 24% a year.

blocks.callout: **So what:** judge Info Edge on two things, not on its consolidated P/E (54x trailing on 30-Sep-2026, on profit that includes fair-value gains): (1) what the operating businesses, above all Naukri, earn and are worth, and (2) what the market pays for the Eternal and PB Fintech stakes, which were 56% of its market value on 30-Sep-2026. The rest of the report is built around those two questions.

sections.title: A cash machine that funds venture bets: two of them made the company's fortune

blocks.p: Naukri needs almost no capital: customers pay up front (deferred revenue ₹1,498 cr at Mar-26), capex is ~₹80 cr a year and consolidated operating cash flow was ₹2,654 cr over FY24-26. Info Edge has used that cash in three ways. (1) **Venture investing**: early stakes in Zomato (cost ₹146 cr) and Policybazaar (cost ₹568 cr) are worth ₹38,386 cr and ₹6,116 cr at 30-Sep-2026 closes; about 135 other start-ups (~₹4,900 cr invested including other investors' money in its AIFs) are worth much less, and ₹673 cr had been written off or provided for by Mar-2023. (2) **Building verticals**: 99acres lost money in every year from FY22 to FY26 while it bought market leadership. (3) **Dividends**: ₹8.40 a share for FY26 (49% of standalone EPS). The cash pile (₹4,963 cr at Mar-26, incl. ₹1,007 cr of unused 2020 QIP money) keeps growing.

blocks.callout: **Capital allocation verdict:** two of the best venture bets in Indian internet history (Zomato and Policybazaar), funded by a near-monopoly that throws off cash. The cost is real too: years of 99acres losses, a long tail of start-ups that will mostly be written off, and a cash pile earning ~7% before tax. Shareholders receive the value of the stakes only through the share price; Info Edge has not sold Eternal or PB Fintech shares since the IPOs.

sections.title: A balance sheet of investments: ₹42,000 cr of them against ₹259 cr of borrowings

blocks.p: At March 2026 the consolidated balance sheet held ₹42,299 cr of investments (Eternal and PB Fintech at fair value ₹35,676 cr, debt funds, the AIF portfolios and joint ventures), ₹3,640 cr of bank deposits inside other financial assets, and only ₹259 cr of borrowings (mostly lease liabilities). Against the unrealised gains sits a deferred tax liability of ₹4,988 cr; non-controlling interests of ₹2,456 cr are mostly the outside investors in Info Edge's venture funds. Screener shows both inside "other liabilities"; net worth below is Info Edge shareholders' equity only.

blocks.callout: **Our read:** a founder-led company (incorporated 1995, the founder still Executive Vice-Chairman), with modest pay, real skin in the game and a strong record of building and investing. The governance question is not integrity but focus: how much of Naukri's cash keeps going into new bets, and whether shareholders ever see the value of the stakes other than through the share price.

sections.title: Our forecasts: standalone EPS ₹21.0 / ₹24.2 / ₹27.6 (FY27-29E)

blocks.p: We forecast the consolidated P&L from four blocks that add up to reported revenue and EBITDA: the three standalone segments (Recruitment, 99acres, Jeevansathi + Shiksha, each on its segment result) and a residual for the subsidiaries and eliminations. A small reconciling line turns segment results into EBITDA (segment results are already after their own depreciation and lease interest). Forecasts carry no fair-value gains, no exceptional items and no minorities of note, so FY27E consolidated profit is below FY26 reported profit even though standalone EBITDA grows ~25%.

sections.title: The street: mostly Buy after the Q1 update; median target ₹1,350

blocks.p: Wide (S&P Global counted 21 analysts in Jun-2026, average target Rs1,300). Notes we could read or that were summarised in the press, standing on 30-Sep-2026: ICICI Securities and Motilal Oswal (Q1FY27 result notes, 10-11 Aug-2026); JM Financial, Citi, JP Morgan and Nomura (after the Q1FY27 business update, 7-8 Jul-2026). Sum of the parts. JM Financial: Recruitment on P/E (22x Mar-28E EPS in May-2026, raised to 30x in Jul-2026), 99acres 4x Mar-28E sales, Jeevansathi and others 2x sales, Eternal and PB Fintech at market less a 25% holding-company discount, other investees at book, cash. Motilal Oswal: Naukri and 99acres on DCF (WACC 11%, terminal growth 4.5%), Eternal and PB Fintech at market (no discount), Jeevansathi and others 10x FY27E EV/sales, other investees, cash. ICICI Securities: SOTP (components not in the sources we could read).

blocks.p: The median of the six notes standing on 30-Sep-2026 is ₹1,350 (range ₹1,250-1,600); S&P Global's 21-analyst average in June was ₹1,300. The swing between brokers is mostly two things: what Naukri is worth (JM's 30x against Motilal Oswal's DCF, worth ~17.1x our Sep-28E Recruitment profit) and whether the stakes deserve a discount (JM 25%, Motilal Oswal none). At JM's 25% the two stakes are worth ₹515 a share; at Motilal Oswal's none, ₹686. The share price fell from ~₹1,363 after the results (11-Aug) to ₹1,220 on 30-Sep-2026, below every target.

blocks.h: What the bears and bulls argue

bullets: **Bear:** AI could shrink white-collar hiring volumes and let recruiters source candidates without Naukri's database (JM Financial, May-2026).
**Bear:** Hiring is replacement-led; mid-tier hiring volumes are weak (management, Q1FY27 call).
**Bear:** Two-thirds of the market value outside Naukri is the Eternal and PB Fintech stakes, which Info Edge has not sold: shareholders get their value only through the share price.
**Bear:** Consolidated profit is dominated by fair-value gains and AIF minorities; reported EPS is not a guide to the operating business.
**Bull:** Q1FY27 Recruitment billings (+17.5%) grew at almost twice the FY26 pace (+10%) and lead revenue by about two quarters; AI products are adding price, not taking volume.
**Bull:** 99acres is turning profitable after years of investment; at 25-30% long-run margins it becomes a second profit pool.
**Bull:** stakes and cash alone are ₹808 a share before any discount; the market pays little for the best classifieds business in India.

blocks.h: The holding-company discount: derived from Info Edge's own history

blocks.p: House method (as in our Godrej Industries and Tube Investments reports): at every quarter-end since Eternal listed (first quarter-end Sep-2021) we compare Info Edge's market value with what it owns on the same conventions as our SOTP: Recruitment at 23.5x the next fiscal year's profit after corporate costs (actual, our estimates for FY27-28), 99acres at 3.75x and Jeevansathi/Shiksha at 2x the next year's revenue, cash at the preceding March and unlisted investments at book. What is left of the market value is what the market pays for the two stakes; the **discount** is how far that falls short of their market value.

blocks.p: **Judging the median against today.** On this convention Info Edge traded at a large *premium* to its look-through value for most of the window (median -85.5%). That is not a holding-company premium: until mid-2025 the market paid 40-90x for Naukri's profit (step 2 above), far more than the 23.5x we and the street use today, and the gap shows up as a negative "discount". Naukri's own re-rating ran through 2025: by Sep-2025 the implied multiple was ~37x and from Mar-2026 it has been 19-28x, inside today's street range. Only the quarter-ends since then measure a discount on a like-for-like basis: Sep-25 -4.0%, Dec-25 -19.0%, Mar-26 21.0%, Jun-26 40.0%, median **8.5%**, against **11.3%** on 30-Sep-2026. So our base 9% is a judgement on a short window, close to today's level and well below JM's 25%. The bull case uses the full-window median floored at zero (no discount, as Motilal Oswal assumes); the bear case the widest quarter-end since Sep-2025 (40%, Jun-2026).
